text: Grok（xAI 订阅）for DeepSeek Harness 是面向 DSH Web 的模型接入插件。它在“设置 → 模型”页面底部提供订阅卡片，并通过 DSH 授权服务启动 xAI OAuth 登录。登录后可将 xAI 提供商和实时 Grok 模型列表同步到模型菜单，也能查看套餐用量、重置时间、上下文窗口、价格与推理能力。适合已有 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 订阅、希望在 DSH 中使用 Grok 的用户；需要相应 xAI 订阅和 DSH 的 Web、授权及凭证服务。

Grok (xAI Subscription) adds a card to DSH Web settings and starts xAI OAuth through DSH authorization. After sign-in, it configures the xAI provider and syncs live Grok models, usage, context, prices, and reasoning capabilities. It requires a SuperGrok or X Premium subscription.

Grok（xAI 订阅）的功能「订阅登录」：用户从模型设置卡片发起 xAI OAuth 设备码登录；授权完成后插件读取凭证并配置 xAI 提供商。
Grok（xAI 订阅）的功能「用量与套餐」：登录后读取套餐、订阅用量、分项和重置信息，并在模型设置卡片展示；可手动刷新。
Grok（xAI 订阅）的功能「实时模型同步」：刷新时读取 xAI 模型目录和单模型能力，将模型列表、上下文及推理选项同步到 DSH 提供商。
Grok（xAI 订阅）的功能「价格信息」：卡片展示实时模型上下文和输入、输出价格，并提供模型推理能力信息。
Grok（xAI 订阅）使用前须知：套餐与用量来自 Grok CLI 的 billing/settings 接口，模型资料来自 xAI API；读取需要向这些服务发送已授权请求。

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 特性：- **订阅登录，不需要 API Key**：通过 xAI 设备码 OAuth 登录，凭证写入 DSH 凭证库的 `llm-pi-ai/xai` 记录。
- **一键接入模型**：登录后自动把 `xai` 提供商写入 `llm-pi-ai`，Grok 模型出现在输入框的模型菜单。
- **订阅用量**：显示套餐（如 SuperGrok Plus）、本周/本月用量百分比、分项、重置时间和预付余额。
- **实时模型列表**：从 `api.x.ai/v1/models` 读取，不再依赖 pi-ai 的内置目录；支持手动刷新并同步。
- **上下文与价格**：模型表显示上下文窗口、输入价格、输出价格；悬停查看缓存输入、长上下文价格和完整模型 ID。
- **推理强度按 xAI 能力校准**：逐个读取 `/v1/models/{id}` 的 `capabilities.reasoning_effort`，不猜测档位；不支持的模型不会出现无效选项。
- **零运行时依赖**：Host 半和 Client 半都是普通 JavaScript，无构建步骤、无第三方 npm 包。

text: @local/dsh-grok-xai README · 实时模型、上下文和价格：> xAI 的模型接口目前不返回最大输出 tokens。同步会保留用户已经写入的 `maxTokens` 和 `compat`；若详情里出现 `max_completion_tokens`、`max_output_tokens` 或 `max_tokens`，才写入 `maxTokens`。否则已知模型复用 pi-ai 目录，未知模型使用路由的保守默认值。
section: 实时模型、上下文和价格

text:
@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 推理强度：同步模型时，插件会逐个请求 `/v1/models/{id}`，只使用 xAI 声明的 `capabilities.reasoning_effort`：

| 模型 | 可选推理强度 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Grok 4.3 | `off / low / medium / high / xhigh` | `off` 映射到 API 的 `none` |
| Grok 4.5 / 4.6 / 4.7 | `low / medium / high / xhigh` | 不支持 `none` |
| Grok 4.20 Reasoning | 固定，无强度选项 | API 拒绝 `reasoningEffort` |
| Grok 4.20 Non-reasoning | 非推理 | 无强度选项 |
| Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent | 固定，无强度选项 | xAI 未声明可切换档位 |
| Grok Build 0.1 | 固定，无强度选项 | API 拒绝 `reasoningEffort` |

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 推理强度：> “固定”表示 xAI 没有给出可切换档位。插件不再把这种情况写成 `reasoningEfforts: false`，因为 DSH 会把 `false` 当成非推理。只有 id 含 `non-reasoning`，或能力里只有 `none`，才写 `false`。其余模型省略该字段，让目录里已有的推理能力保留下来。目录外的模型没有“会推理但不发送强度”的配置形状，所以不会伪造档位。详情请求失败时保留上次写入的推理字段，避免一次失败把推理关掉。强行写死 `low/medium/high` 仍可能触发 400。

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 工作原理：```mermaid flowchart LR U[用户] --> UI["DSH Web UI
设置 → 模型"] UI --> C["client.js
Grok 卡片"] C -->|"同源 JSON
/grok-auth/*"| H["index.js
Host 半"] - **Host 半**：`index.js` 注册 `/grok-auth/*` 同源 JSON 路由；启动设备码登录、读取用量和模型、写回 `llm-pi-ai` 配置。 - **Client 半**：`client.js` 注册到 `settings.models.footer`，渲染登录、用量、模型表和同步操作。 - **凭证**：OAuth 记录由 DSH 的 `authorization` / `credentials` 管理；插件只读取 access token 用于 xAI 请求，不返回、不记录。 - **模型**：同步写入 `providers.xai.models`，所以模型菜单使用 xAI 返回的列表，而不是内置目录。

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 数据与接口：| 接口 | 用途 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET https://api.x.ai/v1/models` | 实时模型列表 | 过滤出可对话模型 |
| `GET https://api.x.ai/v1/models/{id}` | 模型能力与价格 | `capabilities.reasoning_effort` 用于推理校准 |
| `GET https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/billing?format=credits` | 订阅用量 | Grok CLI 使用的未公开端点 |
| `GET https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/settings` | 套餐、默认模型、能力开关 | 未公开端点 |
| `x-ratelimit-*` 响应头 | RPM/TPM 限流窗口 | 仅真实推理响应携带，当前未展示 |
| `GET /v1/api-key` | — | 订阅 OAuth 返回 401，不可用 |
| `GET /v1/usage` | — | 返回 404，xAI 无公开 usage 端点 |

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 安全与隐私：- **令牌不经过插件日志或页面**：OAuth 凭证由 DSH `authorization` / `credentials` 写入 `llm-pi-ai/xai`；插件只把 access token 放进 `Authorization: Bearer` 请求头。
- **同源校验**：`/grok-auth/*` 路由要求请求的 `Origin` 与 `Host` 一致；没有跨站 CORS 接口。
- **无遥测**：插件不收集、不上报任何使用数据。
- **最小权限**：不读取 Grok Bot、Cursor 或其他应用的数据目录；不读取浏览器 Cookie；不访问 keychain。
- **未公开端点**：billing/settings 来自 Grok CLI 的代理端点，xAI 可能随时更改或限制。请只在遵守订阅条款的前提下使用。
- **不要分享凭证**：提交 issue 时不要粘贴 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`、访问令牌、refresh token 或完整请求头。
@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 安全与隐私：发现安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告，不要开公开 issue。

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 已知限制：- 需要有效的 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅；登录成功不代表账号一定有模型权限。
- xAI 的 billing/settings 是未公开端点，可能随版本变化；变化时插件会显示错误而不是伪造数据。
- `/v1/models` 不提供最大输出 tokens；配置使用 pi-ai 目录或路由默认值。
- Grok 4.20 Reasoning / Multi-Agent / Build 0.1 没有可切换的推理档位，这是 xAI 的模型能力，不是插件缺陷。
- 模型列表、价格、上下文会随 xAI 更新；以卡片实时值为准。
- 本地 bundle 以链接方式安装；移动/删除源码目录会导致 profile 依赖失效。
- 主要在 DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证；其他版本的 UI/服务接口可能不同。

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · 故障排查：| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 模型请求报 `Provider is not configured: xai` | 还没完成订阅登录；在卡片登录，或确认 `llm-pi-ai/xai` 凭证存在 |
| 卡片显示「已登录」但模型不可用 | 确认 **设置 → 模型** 中有 `xAI (Grok)` 提供商；没有就点「添加 xAI 提供商」 |
| 报 `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` | 点「刷新并同步模型」；或选择该模型支持的档位 |
| 用量显示「订阅凭证已过期」 | 退出登录后重新登录；插件会自动续期，续期失败才需要重登 |
| 模型菜单没有新模型 | 点「刷新并同步模型」；同步会覆盖 `xai` 提供商的模型列表 |
| 验证码过期 | 重新点「登录 SuperGrok / X Premium」获取新代码 |
| 卡片不出现 | 确认 bundle 已启用；刷新页面；必要时重启 DSH |
| 安装时报路径错误 | 使用克隆目录的**绝对路径**；确认 `package.json` 存在且包含 `dsh.bundle.patch` |

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Grok (xAI Subscription) for DeepSeek Harness：English | [简体中文](README.md)

[](https://github.com/TuDouPn/dsh-grok-xai/actions/workflows/check.yml)

Use **SuperGrok / X Premium** to sign in to xAI from DeepSeek Harness (DSH), call Grok models, and see subscription usage, live models, context windows, and prices.

> **Unofficial project.** Not affiliated with xAI, SpaceXAI, DeepSeek, or Anysphere. The subscription billing/settings endpoints are undocumented Grok CLI proxy endpoints and may change. Use at your own risk and follow xAI's terms.
@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Screenshot：> Plan, weekly usage, live models, context, price, and reasoning efforts.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Features：- **Subscription sign-in, no API key**: xAI device-code OAuth; the credential is stored by DSH as `llm-pi-ai/xai`.
- **Automatic provider setup**: after sign-in, the plugin adds the `xai` provider to `llm-pi-ai`; Grok models appear in the composer model menu.
- **Usage dashboard**: plan (e.g. SuperGrok Plus), weekly/monthly percentage, product breakdown, reset time, and prepaid balance.
- **Live model list**: read from `api.x.ai/v1/models` and synced into the DSH profile instead of relying on the installed catalog.
- **Context and price table**: context window, input/output price per 1M tokens; hover for cached-input and long-context prices.
- **Capability-accurate reasoning efforts**: reads `/v1/models/{id}` and maps only the efforts xAI declares; unsupported models get no fake levels.
- **Zero runtime dependencies**: plain JavaScript Host/Client halves, no build step, no npm packages.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with a Web UI profile (Desktop or `dsh web`).
- The profile must enable `llm-pi-ai`, `authorization`, `credentials`, `configEditor`, and `webServer` (the base Web profile does).
- An active **SuperGrok** or **X Premium** subscription.
- Tested on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` Desktop; other versions may need adaptation.
@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Install：There are two paths. **The recommended one is to give the Git URL to DSH**; no local clone is needed.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Option 1: Install directly from DSH (recommended)：Copy the repository URL:

```text
https://github.com/TuDouPn/dsh-grok-xai.git
```

In a session on the target DSH profile, send this to the agent:

```text

https://github.com/TuDouPn/dsh-grok-xai.git

Check that it is a DSH bundle before installing; after installation, confirm the bundle is enabled and tell me where to open the Grok card.

DSH will:

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Option 2: Clone and install a local bundle：Use this when you want to modify the code or track `main` locally.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TuDouPn/dsh-grok-xai.git
cd dsh-grok-xai
```

**Install from the DSH Web UI**

1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH sidebar.
2. Choose **Install** and enter the **absolute path** to the cloned directory, for example `/Users/you/code/dsh-grok-xai`. If the dialog only accepts a package name or URL, use the agent option below.
3. Approve the operation if prompted, then enable the bundle.

Install the local bundle at /absolute/path/dsh-grok-xai into the current profile and enable it.

Then re-enable the bundle in **Plugins**, or restart DSH. Host-side JavaScript changes may need a reload/restart.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Usage：1. Open **Settings → Models**.
2. In the **Grok (xAI Subscription)** card, click **Sign in with SuperGrok / X Premium**.
3. Open the verification link and enter the one-time code.
4. DSH shows **Signed in** and syncs the live model list.
5. Choose a Grok model in the composer model menu.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Card actions：| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| Sign in / Cancel | Start or cancel the device-code flow |
| Refresh | Re-read subscription usage and the live model list |
| Refresh and sync models | Read `/v1/models` plus per-model capabilities and write them into `llm-pi-ai` |
| Sign out | Delete the local `llm-pi-ai/xai` record; the xAI account is untouched |

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Usage, models, and prices：- **Plan**: `subscription_tier_display` from `cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/settings`.
- **Usage**: `cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/billing?format=credits` — the same source the Grok CLI uses.
- **Models**: `api.x.ai/v1/models` for IDs, context, prices, and long-context thresholds; `api.x.ai/v1/models/{id}` for capabilities.
- **Prices** are USD per 1M tokens. The card shows live values; the README snapshot may age.
- Usage is cached for 5 minutes. Refresh forces a new read. A failed read keeps the last successful snapshot. The plugin refreshes the OAuth token inside DSH's credential-store lock when it is near expiry.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Usage, models, and prices：> xAI does not currently expose a maximum output-token field. Sync keeps a user-set `maxTokens` and `compat`. It writes `maxTokens` only when the detail payload includes `max_completion_tokens`, `max_output_tokens`, or `max_tokens`. Otherwise known models inherit pi-ai catalog metadata, and unknown models use the route defaults.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Reasoning efforts：| Model | Selectable efforts | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Grok 4.3 | `off / low / medium / high / xhigh` | `off` maps to API `none` |
| Grok 4.5 / 4.6 / 4.7 | `low / medium / high / xhigh` | `none` is rejected |
| Grok 4.20 Reasoning | Fixed, no effort options | API rejects `reasoningEffort` |
| Grok 4.20 Non-reasoning | Non-reasoning | No effort options |
| Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent | Fixed, no effort options | xAI declares no switchable efforts |
| Grok Build 0.1 | Fixed, no effort options | API rejects `reasoningEffort` |

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Reasoning efforts：“Fixed” means xAI published no switchable effort. The plugin no longer writes `reasoningEfforts: false` for that case, because DSH treats `false` as non-reasoning. Only ids containing `non-reasoning`, or a capability list of only `none`, are written as `false`. Other models omit the field so an installed catalog entry keeps its reasoning capability. A failed detail read keeps the previously written reasoning field. Guessing `low/medium/high` can still produce HTTP 400.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · How it works：```mermaid flowchart LR U[User] --> UI["DSH Web UI
Settings → Models"] UI --> C["client.js
Grok card"] C -->|"same-origin JSON
/grok-auth/*"| H["index.js
Host half"] The plugin does not depend on Grok Bot or any Anysphere runtime; it uses DSH's own pi-ai xAI adapter and xAI OAuth.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Security and privacy：- Tokens are stored by DSH `authorization`/`credentials` as `llm-pi-ai/xai`; the plugin never logs or returns them.
- `/grok-auth/*` routes require a same-origin `Origin`/`Host` match.
- No telemetry.
- Does not read Grok Bot/Cursor data directories, browser cookies, or the keychain.
- Billing/settings endpoints are undocumented and may change; use them only within your subscription terms.

Report security issues privately via [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Limitations：- Requires an active SuperGrok / X Premium subscription.
- Undocumented billing/settings endpoints may change.
- No maximum output-token metadata from xAI.
- Grok 4.20 Reasoning / Multi-Agent / Build 0.1 have no switchable reasoning effort.
- Prices, models, and context windows change over time.
- Local linked bundle: moving/deleting the checkout breaks the profile dependency.
- Primarily verified on DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`.

@local/dsh-grok-xai README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| `Provider is not configured: xai` | Complete subscription sign-in; verify the `llm-pi-ai/xai` record |
| Signed in but model unavailable | Ensure the `xAI (Grok)` provider exists in Settings → Models |
| `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` | Refresh and sync models; choose a supported level |
| Credential expired | Sign out and sign in again |
| New model missing | Refresh and sync models |
| Card does not appear | Enable the bundle, refresh the page, restart DSH if needed |
